identity_notes: A tripeptide-copper complex. It is not a component of an FDA-approved drug. FDA's categorization differs by route of administration.

status_assertions.qualification: No FDA-approved application is in effect for GHK-Cu.

status_assertions.status_label: Category 1 except injectable; Category 2 for injectable
status_assertions.qualification: FDA placed GHK-Cu in 503A Category 1 for non-injectable routes and Category 2 for injectable routes due to immunogenicity concerns.

timeline.title: FDA updates GHK-Cu categorization
timeline.description: 503A bulk list places GHK-Cu in Category 1 except for injectable routes, which are Category 2.
